title: A hybrid data envelopment analysis-artificial neural network prediction model for COVID-19 severity in transplant recipients.
summary: Retrospective COVID-19 transplant-recipient hospital cohort tested DEA-derived categories with ANN and comparator algorithms; results show improved ANN performance under DEA categorization. Small single-center early-pandemic cohort limits generalization. The result is limited to this study setting and is not evidence of benefit in deployment.
